verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated self-hosted docs page stating it 'runs entirely on your infrastructure: your servers, your browsers, your LLM API keys' (skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-2), and community evidence confirms it is genuinely open-source (AGPL3) rather than just marketing language (skyvern-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-host deployment and clarity on how AGPL licensing affects commercial self-hosting use.
